grade.first_issue: None; the proof is complete and no grading-rule defect applies.
grade.summary: The submission correctly classifies all solutions as f(x)=x+c with c≥0. It verifies the candidates, derives orbit invariance and nonnegativity of g=f-id, proves all positive values of g coincide via a limsup argument, and excludes coexistence of zero and positive defect values through the expanding-interval argument.
strengths: The substitution x=f(y) correctly yields f(f(y))=2f(y)-y and hence linear forward orbits.
The limsup argument rigorously shows that every positive value of g is the same finite constant.
The interval propagation from the right-hand inequality correctly eliminates a mixed zero/positive defect.
The converse is verified by reversible squaring and explicit nonnegative-square identities.
